meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动展开多路调研并生成带引用综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要穷尽式多源调研并产出严谨报告
copy.tagline_en: Automate exhaustive multi-source research and produce cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-source deep research with a polished report

howto.what: 用户要研究时,Claude先提议最终材料(默认PDF+DOCX),再派多组探索者/资料员并行搜代码库、网络、官方文档、开源仓库;实时记录过程,按线索循环扩展搜索,用运行代码验证,最后交付带引用和图表的综合报告,经视觉质检后给出。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求研究时触发(支持任意语言):如说出“ulw-research”、“ultradebate/hyperdebate”,或要求“深度研究/超精确调查”等;普通提问、调试、收集上下文不触发。

say.text: 用ulw-research研究一下Rust异步运行时的现状。
say.note: 触发研究流程,先给出报告格式再展开搜索。

say.text: 做一次深度研究:对比React和Vue的性能。
say.note: 派多组探索者搜代码库、网络和官方文档,并用代码验证。

say.text: 来一场hyperdebate:这份白皮书的论据可靠吗?
say.note: 会以多角度攻击观点,验证后再出综合报告。

howto.what_en: When asked for research, Claude proposes the format (PDF+DOCX default), sends explore+librarian swarms over all sources, journals live, EXPAND-loops on leads, verifies by running code, delivers a cited synthesis with charts after visual QA.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit research requests: 'ulw-research', 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', or 'deep research / ultra-precise investigation', in any language. Ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to study the current state of Rust async runtimes.
say_en.note: Triggers exhaustive research: format first, then search.

say_en.text: Do a deep research: compare React and Vue performance.
Run a hyperdebate: are this whitepaper's arguments sound?
say_en.note: Attacks claims from multiple angles before the synthesis.
